title: Billing Rights Notice Period, Personal Credit Cards
content:
The notice period for a billing dispute on Personal Credit Cards is the number of calendar days after the closing date of the statement on which a charge first appeared within which the cardholder must give notice of the claim.

| Tier | Notice period in calendar days |
|---|---|
| Secured Visa | 60 |
| College Rewards Visa | 60 |
| Platinum Low Rate Visa | 60 |
| Cash Rewards Visa | 60 |
| Travel Rewards Visa Signature | 60 |
| Visa Infinite Private Client | 60 |

The period is 60 calendar days on every tier of Personal Credit Cards, so the tier a cardholder holds never lengthens or shortens it.
